in_marathi.name: Avhan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Avhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Avhan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Avah' which means 'desirable' or 'lovable'. In Hindu mythology, Avhan is the name of the divine son of Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati.
